prior_terminal: v1.321 ORIGINAL all-site equal-effort gate STOP: 80 Event records, 78 source site keys after one unparseable effort source row, 73 source-overlap sites of which 72 have exactly 1 hour + 1 has 30 minutes. The original v1.321 hypothesis must stay TERMINAL, no retrospectively relabeled pass.
rationale: The PRIBES authors' published method specifies exactly one hour per physical site. A source-uniform 1-hour subsurvey, selected before seeing ANY PRIBES species or establishmentMeans values, is an observational study of the published standard protocol rather than a mix of unequal exposure. This is a NEW lower-evidence, explicitly post-source-Event-quality design; not a confirmed original 80-row equal-effort cohort.

event_only_site_selection.source_island_map: Same pre-frozen exact island normalization of v1.321
event_only_site_selection.source_physical_locationID: Same source original Unicode-folded uppercase alphanumeric locationID of v1.321. No coordinate nearest neighbor matching or token shortening.
event_only_site_selection.one_hour_only: Require original sampleSizeValue exactly numeric 1.0 and normalized sampleSizeUnit exactly 'hour', original samplingProtocol exactly casefold/whitespace 'vegetation beating'. Any original Event with unknown effort or 30 minutes is not eligible.
event_only_site_selection.duplicate_site_rule: From eligible identical one-hour Events of the same exact island+locationID, choose lexicographically smallest original source coreID; if >1 original rows at site differ coordinates >0.0003 degrees or methods, fail; discarded source Events are identified by source only, never taxon.
event_only_site_selection.source_survey_years: 2019 to 2025, verified from original eventDate and year fields
event_only_site_selection.site_spatial_coordinates: Original decimalLat/Lon finite and source duplicate key consistent; do not export actual locations.
event_only_site_selection.preserve_declared_sample_effort: Do not infer one hour from published prose for records where original source hours field is missing. No imputation or rescaling 30-minute record to one hour.
event_only_site_selection.output: Only original full-hour selected source Event coreid SHA256, counts by original island, year, number excluded by exact source issue; no author site identifiers or original biological taxon values.

subsequent_steps: If 72 exact six-island site opportunities are verified, freeze taxon response origin and island-level introduced Beetle ubiquity compare to unchanged BALA source-free six island forest beta (v1.323).
Before any original PRIBES species read, test this study's source data ontology and habitat source-pool metric as fixed in v1.320. If primary non-estimable, STOP not choose new geographic threshold.
No PRIBES species, taxonRank, establishmentMeans, organismQuantity, environmental or BALA outcome rows can influence site or method selection.
scientific_boundary: 1-hour cross-sectional ruderal beetle distribution is a proxy for potential source pressure, not measured forest dispersal. Different PRIBES plant beating/BALA Pitfall detectability, N=6 overlapping island contexts, and temporal asynchrony prevent causal/mechanistic inference.
